headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseProfileCode_inverseDefectState
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)
  (st : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.InverseLocalLabels r c U L X),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseProfileCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X) (↑(↑(↑st).1).1, ↑(↑(↑st).1).2)
      (↑(↑(↑st).2).1, ↑(↑(↑st).2).2) =
    Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L
      ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseDefectState r c U L X st)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceFallbackCode_code
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceFallbackCode xs ys =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceFallback xs ys htotal)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceInitializationCode_initialStart
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceInitializationCode xs ys htotal =
    some
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys) 7
        ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceInitialStart xs ys htotal hb))
